item.title: v0.1.4
item.description: - Double-clicking a button along the top of a window in apps like Claude no longer maximizes the window. Double-clicking an empty part of the title bar still does. - The volume and brightness overlay now appears in the right place on a screen that sits above another one. - The volume and brightness overlay is now centred along the top of the screen while an app is full screen. - The volume and brightness overlay no longer jumps to the corner of the screen just after you log in or when the menu bar is hidden.
